reviews.inspectionOrderDetail: Read governance/contract and actual M7 reference PNGs first. Inspected all unique current PNGs and initial complete-journey video sequences; fixed first fresh-media observations before opening prior blocked-review substance. Then completed all 12 temporal-media/raw-trace analyses and historical resolution. No app implementation source or builder rationale was read; schema constants/validator, protected policy registry, captured rendered CSS and supplemental execution receipts were read only as bounded evidence. Detailed private provenance is retained separately.
reviews.iterationsMeaning: Cumulative fourth review authorized only for Reach PR766/reach.phase1.foundation by protectedM7 continuation; no reset or fifth iteration.

composition.observation: The welcome puts a large registered camera stage beside one guidance column inside a continuous sea-green instrument panel. During calibration the pointing plane becomes the dominant desktop surface, while mobile moves progress and target above the camera. Brass actions and warm serif task headings carry the accepted M7 family without copying its cinematic empty height. The returned parent is deliberately simpler and has a minor alignment opportunity recorded separately.

hierarchy.observation: Find your point identifies the task; Prepare, Calibrate, Check and Explore identify progress. Nine-target completion explicitly says Independent check required, and a fresh five-target phase precedes Independent check passed. The same distinction survives the mobile compact panel. Camera availability, hand count, framing, posture readiness and the next useful action have separate text rather than a single success badge.

typography.observation: Warm serif display and stage headings are separated from readable sans-serif instructions and small monospaced instrument metadata. At 390px the title, guidance, pause and result messages wrap within their surfaces, and target numbers remain legible. Small plane headers are secondary to the large numbered target and progress text. No task-defining label is visibly truncated in the reviewed PNGs.

spacing.observation: Desktop target and guidance have clear gutters and bounded cards; mobile controls wrap into two rows with readable separation and the target retains a consistent inner area. The five raw partial-overlap contrast cases correspond to readable mobile progress spans and the return paragraph, which I inspected directly. The parent heading/entry link beginning at the viewport edge while its desktop card is inset is nonblocking polish, not an observed obstruction.

controls.observation: Primary brass buttons, outlined alternatives, native labeled radio choices, the condition select, pause/resume, retry/cancel and visible return remain understandable. The recorded flow actually activates named controls with Enter and uses ArrowDown/Home/Enter for mode and condition changes. The hand-plane interaction stays a disclosed laboratory exercise; ordinary buttons and navigation remain available. No gesture-only gate is introduced in these selected journeys.

contrast.observation: I reviewed every distinct PNG and all 173 incomplete-rule render signatures rather than accepting the serious-only summary. The 96 raw axe results contain no violations at any severity; all 2670 incompletes are retained and adjudicated separately. Conservative captured-dark-style text palettes give 5.9781:1 or greater for mapped text; decorative/redundant symbols and the silent local preview have specific applicability dispositions. Progress, error, eligibility and completion also use text or shape. These are bounded color/render observations, not a certification of unobserved themes, live video backgrounds or all nontext contrast.

consistency.observation: The current laboratory shares the accepted M7 reference family: coherent Voyagewright shell, restrained brass, dark sea-green surfaces, warm serif task headings and grouped controls. Normal/reduced and desktop/mobile preserve the same stages and claims. The conventional parent keeps the same brand/navigation and a designed sign-in card, though its edge-aligned heading/link are visually less composed; this is the one minor polish finding.

states.observation: All 15 selected states have current evidence: camera off, disclosed simulated tracking, absolute training, pause, setup-ready, held-out validation, result, playground, multiple hands, detected-but-ineligible framing, relative training/check/result, camera unavailable and return. Pausing retains target/progress and offers Resume. Setup never claims the independent result, edge framing changes guidance and hides the pointer, and camera failure provides retry/demo. The state ledger retains all 84 PNG entries and all 392 contract steps with raw calls.

responsive.observation: At 1440 × 900 desktop and 390 × 844 mobile all selected text/control groups fit without recorded horizontal overflow. Mobile preparation prioritizes the camera, calibration prioritizes the target and progress, and controls wrap below. Core outer-target circles, numbers and collection arcs remain visible; their soft halos crowd/clip the plane edge and label zone, which is minor density rather than blocked recognition. Mobile viewport recordings are keyboard-driven browser evidence and do not prove physical touch, Safari, wide-tablet or200%zoom behavior.

keyboard.observation: Every selected contract step is matched in order to current raw calls:392 total, no missing or failed calls. The 12contexts contain512 Tab presses,188 targeted Enter activations and the explicit radio/combobox Home/ArrowDown/Enter operations; no click/tap calls occur. Thus conventional keyboard controls execute the selected setup, pause/resume, training, checks, practice, recovery and return. Because targeted locator.press may focus its target, these calls alone do not prove the naturally Tab-selected element at every activation. No universal Tab-order or physical-touch claim is made.

focus.observation: Current pixels show strong focus outlines on the entry H1, newly active pointing plane, Resume button and condition select, with meaningful stage content visible around them. Raw selected snapshots supply one Reach H1 and a named guidance SECTION region; return supplies a named MAIN and H1. No raw activeElement/:focus evaluator proves exact heading restoration or each preceding Tab selection, so those broader claims are withheld. The prior heading/landmark repairs are independently supported by current semantics, not inferred from focus:true summaries.

feedback.observation: Hold text, numbered targets, percent/progress bars, pause/resume wording and explicit setup/check results explain what changed. Named Reach status and polite session messages expose readiness and stage meaning in the captured DOM. Raw specific-ready-text bounds are816.588–848.426 ms across12contexts; the original capture metric is835.454–869.634 ms, both below 5,000 ms. Other extracted transition bounds including target collection remain below 1,817 ms. These are software selector-observation bounds, not exposure/inference/display latency. One redundant Next route announcer stays on the parent label in one trace; correct H1/status remain present and actual speech is unrecorded.

motion.observation: All 12recordings were inspected as timestamped sequential samples, with native fine frames around target movement, brief relative playgrounds, camera failure and return. Normal relative target2 visibly slides left while reduced places it directly; both retain the changing collection arc, bar, percentage and hold text. Normal mobile camera return blends outgoing and destination content for about 0.24 s; reduced returns cleanly. No persistent stalled or misleading stage was observed. This sampled temporal review does not claim that every7709decoded frame was watched in real time or certify all frame pacing.

continuity.observation: All 12current journeys begin from the visible laboratory link on device connections and return through the visible conventional return control to Connect your device, the laboratory entry and the anonymous sign-in card. The home-origin href digest is unchanged before/outcome/after in all capture receipts. Fine frames show camera-off reset before route completion; resource teardown and exact prior focus/scroll restoration are not proved by pixels. Pairing/progression authority is not claimed by the lab. The 56 raw Crossdeck401console events at anonymous entry/return are disclosed, with no page/call error or blocked Reach outcome.

complexity.observation: The default view exposes one immediate camera/demo choice, then a clearly described relative-versus-experimental-absolute choice. Stage-specific controls replace the previous task, the camera becomes compact during calibration, and technical measurements stay behind Session diagnostics & privacy. Plain-language guidance identifies the next useful action. The staged workspace is information-rich without requiring the person to decode diagnostic enums or hidden URLs to complete the selected journeys.

role-outcomes.observation: The anonymous persona enters Reach without pairing or granting camera access, performs the disclosed D0 demo, trains 9 absolute or 5 relative positions, completes 5 independent checks, reaches the separate playground and returns. Absolute Pointing error and relative Cursor error use distinct claims; repeated demo/camera-off/accuracy disclaimers prevent 0.00% simulated results being presented as real-person validation. The multiple-hand and framing states keep detection distinct from readiness. Authenticated focus development receipt is supplemental only; no authenticated C4media or owner acceptance is claimed.

fallbacks.observation: Camera failure truthfully says it could not start and leaves Retry live camera and Explore guided demo available. The recovery recording proceeds into a plainly simulated no-camera hand flow and returns to ordinary navigation. Relative movement is recommended with a distinct cursor-control check, while absolute remains experimental. Conventional controls remain usable when live tracking is unavailable; selected ordinary fallback and return have actual outcomes rather than only button presence. No real-camera failure taxonomy or Safari/device guarantee is inferred.

findings.observation: C3 recorded a nested complementary Reach guidance aside. Current selected-state raw DOM instead contains SECTION aria-label="Reach guidance" within MAIN, with no ASIDE or complementary role; the named SECTION remains an appropriate region. Guidance content and stage instructions remain visibly present. All 96fullcurrentaxe results contain no landmark violation at any severity.
findings.resolution: Fresh C4 actual snapshots across all selected Reach states and all 12trace contexts show the guidance container as a named SECTION region rather than a nested complementary aside. The current raw audit removes the specific landmark-complementary-is-top-level violation without removing guidance. This resolves the exact C3 semantic defect under GP15.3; speech output and universal focus restoration are not inferred.

findings.observation: C3 recorded no H1 on the returned anonymous device-connections page. Every current RETURNED snapshot contains H1 id="device-connections-heading" tabindex="-1" with Connect your device inside MAIN aria-labelledby="device-connections-heading", followed by the existing sign-in-card H2. Desktop and mobile PNGs visibly show the page heading and existing destinations.
findings.resolution: All 12freshreturned-state DOM snapshots provide a semantic level-one page heading and named main; current full axe results no longer report page-has-heading-one. The return still reaches the visible laboratory link and conventional sign-in action. The exact missing-H1 defect is resolved; an H1 tabindex alone is not claimed as proof of focus restoration.

findings.observation: The returned parent places Connect your device and the laboratory entry link at the viewport edge while the desktop sign-in card is inset, so it feels less composed than the laboratory. The heading, link, explanation and sign-in action remain readable and reachable on desktop/mobile.
findings.severityRationale: An alignment/visual-rhythm opportunity, with no clipping, misleading state, hidden destination, raw form, semantic violation or demonstrated task obstruction. This is not reclassified baseline debt and is not a waiver of a blocking requirement.
findings.suggestedRepair: In future ordinary polish, align the parent heading and entry link with its content container while preserving the current semantic heading and destinations.

reviews.decision: ACCEPTED for the bounded current anonymous D0 software rendered experience: the staged camera/demo/calibration/check/playground/fallback/return journey is coherent and truthful across selected desktop/mobile normal/reduced contexts; both historical semantic blockers are resolved. One nonblocking parent-spacing opportunity is recorded. This decision rests on actual rendered and raw semantic evidence, not capture success, screenshot counts or serious-only axe summaries. Authenticated submission, source replay and ordinary protected verification remain with the execution owner.
